Amaura

Rock Ice

Kalos · Generation 6

Amaura is a Rock/Ice-type Tundra Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 25.2 kg. It evolves into Aurorus. Its highest base stat is HP (77), with a base stat total of 362.
